name: Biblical Tels - Megiddo, Hazor, Beer Sheba
description: Three ancient mounds in Israel, Megiddo, Hazor and Beer Sheba, each hold layers of cities stacked up over thousands of years and linked to stories in the Bible. Hazor is the biggest, with a 12-hectare upper mound and a lower city of over 70 hectares. Visitors can also explore the deep underground tunnels the Iron Age cities dug to secure their water.
